name: Gross Order Value (GOV)
formula_expression: Sum(Item Prices + Delivery + Packaging + Taxes) - Restaurant Discounts
audit_constraints: Direct comparison valid only across identical definitions.

name: Net Order Value (NOV)
formula_expression: GOV - Indirect Customer Taxes - Platform Funded Discounts
mathematical_properties: Used by Blinkit as primary headline scale metric.
audit_constraints: Cannot be subtracted directly from Swiggy Instamart GOV.

name: Average Order Value (AOV)
formula_expression: Order Flow Denominator (GOV or NOV) / Total Completed Orders
mathematical_properties: Reported or derived as Order Flow / Orders.
audit_constraints: Must preserve denominator: GOV-AOV vs NOV-AOV.

name: Waterfall Growth Decomposition
economic_purpose: Decouples volume expansion from basket size inflation.
mathematical_properties: Exact additive identity with zero residual (0.00 Cr).
audit_constraints: Decomposition of GOV decomposes GOV; NOV decomposes NOV.

name: Contribution Margin %
formula_expression: (Revenue - Direct Variable Fulfillment Costs) / Order Flow Denominator * 100
mathematical_properties: Swiggy uses GOV denominator; Blinkit uses NOV denominator.
audit_constraints: Preserve denominator basis; do not cross-divide.

name: Segment Adjusted EBITDA %
formula_expression: Contribution Profit - Dark Store Rent - Utilities - Labor - Local Marketing
economic_purpose: Operating margin before unallocated corporate overhead.
mathematical_properties: Reported under Ind AS 108 segment reporting.
audit_constraints: Direct subtraction requires Level 3 Directional caveat.

name: Dark Store Daily Throughput
formula_expression: Quarterly Order Flow / (Store Count * Days in Quarter)
economic_purpose: Average sales per store per day.
audit_constraints: Never divide quarterly NOV by 365 days.

name: Instamart Break-Even AOV
formula_expression: Current AOV + (|Current CM %| / OLS Slope bps) * 100
mathematical_properties: OLS slope = 0.9506 bps/₹1 from historical quarterly pairs.
audit_constraints: Empirical observational elasticity; not guaranteed causal lever.

name: Chow Structural Break F-Test
economic_purpose: Statistical test for parameter change across corporate event.
audit_constraints: Reject null of parameter stability at p < 0.05.
